mapper.select: SELECT u.username AS traineeName, u.user_profile_url AS traineeProfileUrl, c.room_id, c.status, t.title AS trainingTitle, c.latest_message AS latestMessage, c.latest_at AS latestAt FROM counselings c JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.user_id JOIN trainings t ON c.training_id = t.training_id WHERE c.trainer_id = #{trainerId} ORDER BY c.latest_at DESC
SELECT * FROM counselings WHERE room_id = #{roomId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO counselings ( user_id, trainer_id, training_id, room_id, status, latest_message, latest_at, start_at, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{trainerId}, #{trainingId}, #{roomId}, #{status}, #{latestMessage}, #{latestAt}, #{startAt}, #{expiresAt} )
